fact.en: All electromagnetic waves, from radio waves to gamma rays, travel at the same speed in a vacuum: 3 x 10^8 meters per second, which is the speed of light.
fact.tl: Lahat ng electromagnetic waves, mula radio waves hanggang gamma rays, ay bumibiyahe sa parehong bilis sa vacuum: 3 x 10^8 meters per second, na siyang bilis ng liwanag.
fact.bis: Ang tanang electromagnetic waves, gikan sa radio waves hangtod sa gamma rays, mobiyahe sa samang gikusgon sa vacuum: 3 x 10^8 metros kada segundo, nga mao ang gikusgon sa kahayag.

cards.illustration: A beam of light from a flashlight traveling through a dark, empty space with a speedometer showing 3 x 10^8 m/s.

fact.en: The electromagnetic spectrum is arranged from radio waves, which have the longest wavelength, to gamma rays, which have the shortest wavelength.
fact.tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum ay nakaayos mula sa radio waves, na may pinakamahabang wavelength, hanggang sa gamma rays, na may pinakamaikling wavelength.
fact.bis: Ang electromagnetic spectrum gihan-ay sugod sa radio waves, nga adunay kinatas-ang wavelength, hangtod sa gamma rays, nga adunay kinamub-an nga wavelength.

cards.illustration: A long horizontal line with a big radio tower on the left end and a small glowing gamma ray symbol on the right end.

fact.en: Radio waves have the longest wavelength and the lowest frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum, making them the least energetic.
fact.tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamahabang wavelength at pinakamababang frequency sa electromagnetic spectrum, kaya sila ang may pinakamababang energy.
fact.bis: Ang radio waves adunay kinatas-ang wavelength ug kinagamyan nga frequency sa electromagnetic spectrum, busa sila ang adunay kinagamyan nga energy.

cards.illustration: A tall radio tower emitting a long, gentle wave that stretches across the sky.

fact.en: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and the highest frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum, making them the most energetic and penetrating.
fact.tl: Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamaikling wavelength at pinakamataas na frequency sa electromagnetic spectrum, kaya sila ang may pinakamataas na energy at pinakamalakas tumagos.
fact.bis: Ang gamma rays adunay kinamub-an nga wavelength ug kinatas-ang frequency sa electromagnetic spectrum, busa sila ang adunay kinatas-ang energy ug kusog kaayong motuhop.

cards.illustration: A tiny, bright gamma ray symbol with very tight, jagged waves radiating from it.

fact.en: The speed of an electromagnetic wave equals its frequency multiplied by its wavelength, written as c = fλ, where c is the speed of light.
fact.tl: Ang bilis ng electromagnetic wave ay katumbas ng frequency nito na minultiplika sa wavelength, na isinusulat bilang c = fλ, kung saan ang c ay bilis ng liwanag.
fact.bis: Ang gikusgon sa electromagnetic wave katumbas sa frequency nga gipilo sa wavelength, gisulat isip c = fλ, diin ang c mao ang gikusgon sa kahayag.

cards.illustration: A simple equation c = fλ written on a chalkboard with a small wave drawn next to it.

fact.en:
Why do radio waves have low frequency while gamma rays have high frequency?

Because frequency and wavelength are inversely related! When wavelength is long, like in radio waves, frequency is low. When wavelength is short, like in gamma rays, frequency is high.
fact.tl:
Bakit mababa ang frequency ng radio waves samantalang mataas ang frequency ng gamma rays?

Dahil ang frequency at wavelength ay inversely related! Kapag mahaba ang wavelength, tulad sa radio waves, mababa ang frequency. Kapag maikli ang wavelength, tulad sa gamma rays, mataas ang frequency.
fact.bis:
Ngano nga ubos ang frequency sa radio waves samtang taas ang frequency sa gamma rays?

Tungod kay ang frequency ug wavelength inversely related! Kon taas ang wavelength, sama sa radio waves, ubos ang frequency. Kon mubo ang wavelength, sama sa gamma rays, taas ang frequency.

cards.illustration: A seesaw with a long wave on one side and a low frequency number on the other, balancing a short wave and a high frequency number.

fact.en: Electromagnetic waves carry energy called radiation, which is why they are also known as electromagnetic radiation.
fact.tl: Ang electromagnetic waves ay nagdadala ng energy na tinatawag na radiation, kaya tinatawag din silang electromagnetic radiation.
fact.bis: Ang electromagnetic waves nagdala ug energy nga gitawag ug radiation, mao nga gitawag usab sila nga electromagnetic radiation.

cards.illustration: A glowing sun emitting waves that carry small packets of energy outward.

fact.en: The energy of an electromagnetic wave is directly proportional to its frequency, as shown by Planck's equation E = hf, where h is Planck's constant.
fact.tl: Ang energy ng electromagnetic wave ay directly proportional sa frequency nito, ayon sa Planck's equation na E = hf, kung saan ang h ay Planck's constant.
fact.bis: Ang energy sa electromagnetic wave directly proportional sa frequency, sumala sa Planck's equation nga E = hf, diin ang h mao ang Planck's constant.

cards.illustration: A glowing equation E = hf on a dark background with a small wave and a light bulb next to it.

fact.en: Planck's constant is a very tiny number, 6.63 x 10^-34 joule-seconds, that connects the energy of a wave to its frequency.
fact.tl: Ang Planck's constant ay napakaliit na numero, 6.63 x 10^-34 joule-seconds, na nag-uugnay sa energy ng wave sa frequency nito.
fact.bis: Ang Planck's constant usa ka hilabihan ka gamay nga numero, 6.63 x 10^-34 joule-seconds, nga nagkonektar sa energy sa wave ngadto sa frequency.

cards.illustration: A magnifying glass showing the tiny number 6.63 x 10^-34 J·s written on a small speck.

fact.en:
Why do gamma rays have more energy than radio waves?

Because energy is inversely proportional to wavelength! Gamma rays have a much shorter wavelength than radio waves, so they carry much more energy.
fact.tl:
Bakit mas maraming energy ang gamma rays kaysa radio waves?

Dahil ang energy ay inversely proportional sa wavelength! Ang gamma rays ay may mas maikling wavelength kaysa radio waves, kaya mas marami silang dalang energy.
fact.bis:
Ngano nga mas daghan ug energy ang gamma rays kaysa radio waves?

Tungod kay ang energy inversely proportional sa wavelength! Ang gamma rays adunay mas mubo nga wavelength kaysa radio waves, busa mas daghan sila ug dala nga energy.

cards.illustration: A short, jagged gamma ray wave next to a tall energy bar, and a long, gentle radio wave next to a short energy bar.

fact.en: Higher frequency and shorter wavelength mean higher energy for an electromagnetic wave, so gamma rays are more energetic than radio waves.
fact.tl: Ang mas mataas na frequency at mas maikling wavelength ay nangangahulugan ng mas mataas na energy para sa electromagnetic wave, kaya mas masigla ang gamma rays kaysa radio waves.
fact.bis: Ang mas taas nga frequency ug mas mubo nga wavelength nagpasabot ug mas taas nga energy alang sa electromagnetic wave, busa mas kusgan ang gamma rays kaysa radio waves.

cards.illustration: A comparison of a tall, jagged wave labeled with high energy and a short, gentle wave labeled with low energy.

fact.en:
Are all electromagnetic waves equally dangerous?

No! Low-frequency EM waves like radio waves are less dangerous than high-frequency EM waves like X-rays and gamma rays, because high frequency means more energy.
fact.tl:
Pareho bang mapanganib ang lahat ng electromagnetic waves?

Hindi! Ang low-frequency EM waves tulad ng radio waves ay hindi gaanong mapanganib kaysa high-frequency EM waves tulad ng X-rays at gamma rays, dahil ang mataas na frequency ay nangangahulugan ng mas maraming energy.
fact.bis:
Parehas ba nga peligroso ang tanang electromagnetic waves?

Dili! Ang low-frequency EM waves sama sa radio waves dili kaayo peligroso kaysa high-frequency EM waves sama sa X-rays ug gamma rays, tungod kay ang taas nga frequency nagpasabot ug mas daghan nga energy.

cards.illustration: A scale showing a radio wave on the safe green side and a gamma ray on the dangerous red side.

fact.en: Ultraviolet rays from the sun can damage skin, but sunscreens are designed to block these rays before they reach your body.
fact.tl: Ang ultraviolet rays mula sa araw ay maaaring makasira ng balat, ngunit ang mga sunscreen ay ginawa upang harangan ang mga ray na ito bago pa man umabot sa iyong katawan.
fact.bis: Ang ultraviolet rays gikan sa adlaw makadaot sa panit, apan ang mga sunscreen gihimo aron babagan kini nga mga ray sa dili pa kini moabot sa imong lawas.

cards.illustration: A child applying sunscreen on their arm while the sun shines down with UV rays bouncing off the skin.

fact.en: Infrared rays are felt as heat on your skin, which is why they are often called heat rays.
fact.tl: Ang infrared rays ay nararamdaman bilang init sa iyong balat, kaya madalas silang tinatawag na heat rays.
fact.bis: Ang infrared rays mabati isip kainit sa imong panit, mao nga kanunay silang gitawag nga heat rays.

cards.illustration: A person holding their hand near a warm campfire, with wavy heat lines rising from the fire.

fact.en:
What is the wavelength of a microwave with a frequency of 3 x 10^9 Hz?

Using c = fλ, the wavelength is 0.1 meters, or about the length of your hand!
fact.tl:
Ano ang wavelength ng microwave na may frequency na 3 x 10^9 Hz?

Gamit ang c = fλ, ang wavelength ay 0.1 metro, o halos kasinghaba ng iyong kamay!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang wavelength sa microwave nga adunay frequency nga 3 x 10^9 Hz?

Gamit ang c = fλ, ang wavelength kay 0.1 metros, o halos sama ka taas sa imong kamot!

cards.illustration: A microwave oven with a wave drawn next to it, and a hand shown for size comparison.

fact.en:
What is the frequency of a radio wave with a wavelength of 20 meters?

Using c = fλ, the frequency is 1.5 x 10^7 Hz, which is 15 million cycles per second!
fact.tl:
Ano ang frequency ng radio wave na may wavelength na 20 metro?

Gamit ang c = fλ, ang frequency ay 1.5 x 10^7 Hz, na 15 milyong cycle bawat segundo!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang frequency sa radio wave nga adunay wavelength nga 20 metros?

Gamit ang c = fλ, ang frequency kay 1.5 x 10^7 Hz, nga 15 ka milyon ka cycle kada segundo!

cards.illustration: A radio tower with a long wave stretching out, and a counter showing 15 million cycles per second.

fact.en:
How much energy does an X-ray carry at a frequency of 5 x 10^17 Hz?

Using E = hf, the energy is 3.315 x 10^-16 joules, a tiny but powerful amount!
fact.tl:
Gaano karaming energy ang dala ng X-ray sa frequency na 5 x 10^17 Hz?

Gamit ang E = hf, ang energy ay 3.315 x 10^-16 joules, isang napakaliit ngunit malakas na halaga!
fact.bis:
Pila ka energy ang dala sa X-ray sa frequency nga 5 x 10^17 Hz?

Gamit ang E = hf, ang energy kay 3.315 x 10^-16 joules, usa ka hilabihan ka gamay apan kusgan nga kantidad!

cards.illustration: An X-ray machine emitting a beam, with a small energy packet labeled 3.315 x 10^-16 J.

fact.en:
What is the wavelength of a UV ray with a frequency of 9 x 10^15 Hz?

Using c = fλ, the wavelength is 3.33 x 10^-8 meters, much shorter than a human hair!
fact.tl:
Ano ang wavelength ng UV ray na may frequency na 9 x 10^15 Hz?

Gamit ang c = fλ, ang wavelength ay 3.33 x 10^-8 metro, mas maikli pa kaysa buhok ng tao!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang wavelength sa UV ray nga adunay frequency nga 9 x 10^15 Hz?

Gamit ang c = fλ, ang wavelength kay 3.33 x 10^-8 metros, mas mubo pa kaysa buhok sa tawo!

cards.illustration: A UV ray from the sun with a very short wave drawn next to a strand of hair for comparison.

fact.en: Visible light, the only part of the electromagnetic spectrum our eyes can see, has wavelengths from about 400 to 700 nanometers.
fact.tl: Ang visible light, ang tanging bahagi ng electromagnetic spectrum na nakikita ng ating mga mata, ay may wavelength mula 400 hanggang 700 nanometers.
fact.bis: Ang visible light, ang bugtong bahin sa electromagnetic spectrum nga makita sa atong mga mata, adunay wavelength gikan sa 400 hangtod 700 nanometers.

cards.illustration: A rainbow with a ruler showing the 400 to 700 nanometer range.

fact.en:
Which color of visible light has the longest wavelength?

Red light has the longest wavelength, around 700 nanometers, while violet light has the shortest, around 400 nanometers!
fact.tl:
Aling kulay ng visible light ang may pinakamahabang wavelength?

Ang pulang ilaw ang may pinakamahabang wavelength, humigit-kumulang 700 nanometers, samantalang ang violet na ilaw ang may pinakamaikli, humigit-kumulang 400 nanometers!
fact.bis:
Asa nga kolor sa visible light ang adunay kinatas-ang wavelength?

Ang pula nga kahayag ang adunay kinatas-ang wavelength, mga 700 nanometers, samtang ang violet nga kahayag ang adunay kinamub-an, mga 400 nanometers!

cards.illustration: A spectrum of visible light with red on the left end and violet on the right end, with wavelength numbers below.

fact.en: Infrared waves have wavelengths between 7 x 10^-7 meters and 1 x 10^-3 meters, longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves.
fact.tl: Ang infrared waves ay may wavelength sa pagitan ng 7 x 10^-7 metro at 1 x 10^-3 metro, mas mahaba kaysa visible light ngunit mas maikli kaysa microwaves.
fact.bis: Ang infrared waves adunay wavelength tali sa 7 x 10^-7 metros ug 1 x 10^-3 metros, mas taas kaysa visible light apan mas mubo kaysa microwaves.

cards.illustration: A scale showing infrared waves between visible light and microwaves, with their wavelengths labeled.

fact.en: Gamma rays are highly penetrating waves, meaning they can pass through many materials, which is why they are used carefully in medical treatments.
fact.tl: Ang gamma rays ay highly penetrating waves, ibig sabihin kaya nilang tumagos sa maraming materyales, kaya maingat silang ginagamit sa mga medikal na paggamot.
fact.bis: Ang gamma rays kay highly penetrating waves, nagpasabot nga makalusot sila sa daghang materyales, mao nga mainampingon silang gigamit sa mga medikal nga pagtambal.

cards.illustration: A gamma ray beam passing through a thick metal plate, with a doctor using a machine in the background.

fact.en: Low-frequency electromagnetic waves include radio waves, microwaves, infrared waves, and visible light, and they are generally less dangerous than high-frequency waves.
fact.tl: Ang low-frequency electromagnetic waves ay kinabibilangan ng radio waves, microwaves, infrared waves, at visible light, at karaniwang hindi gaanong mapanganib kaysa high-frequency waves.
fact.bis: Ang low-frequency electromagnetic waves naglakip sa radio waves, microwaves, infrared waves, ug visible light, ug sa kasagaran dili kaayo peligroso kaysa high-frequency waves.

cards.illustration: A group of four waves, from radio to visible light, shown with a green safe zone background.

fact.en: High-frequency electromagnetic waves include ultraviolet rays, X-rays, and gamma rays, and they carry more energy than low-frequency waves.
fact.tl: Ang high-frequency electromagnetic waves ay kinabibilangan ng ultraviolet rays, X-rays, at gamma rays, at nagdadala sila ng mas maraming energy kaysa low-frequency waves.
fact.bis: Ang high-frequency electromagnetic waves naglakip sa ultraviolet rays, X-rays, ug gamma rays, ug nagdala sila ug mas daghan nga energy kaysa low-frequency waves.

cards.illustration: A group of three waves, from ultraviolet to gamma rays, shown with a red caution zone background.

fact.en:
What happens to the energy of an electromagnetic wave when its frequency doubles?

The energy also doubles! Energy is directly proportional to frequency, so if frequency goes up, energy goes up by the same amount.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa energy ng electromagnetic wave kapag dumoble ang frequency nito?

Dodoble rin ang energy! Ang energy ay directly proportional sa frequency, kaya kung tumaas ang frequency, tataas din ang energy sa parehong halaga.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa energy sa electromagnetic wave kon modoble ang frequency?

Modoble usab ang energy! Ang energy directly proportional sa frequency, busa kon mosaka ang frequency, mosaka usab ang energy sa samang kantidad.

cards.illustration: A graph with frequency on the x-axis and energy on the y-axis, showing a straight line going up.

fact.en:
What happens to the energy of an electromagnetic wave when its wavelength gets shorter?

The energy gets higher! Energy is inversely proportional to wavelength, so a shorter wavelength means more energy.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa energy ng electromagnetic wave kapag umikli ang wavelength nito?

Tataas ang energy! Ang energy ay inversely proportional sa wavelength, kaya ang mas maikling wavelength ay nangangahulugan ng mas maraming energy.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa energy sa electromagnetic wave kon mubo ang wavelength?

Mosaka ang energy! Ang energy inversely proportional sa wavelength, busa ang mas mubo nga wavelength nagpasabot ug mas daghan nga energy.

cards.illustration: A graph with wavelength on the x-axis and energy on the y-axis, showing a curve going down as wavelength increases.

fact.en:
How much energy does a microwave carry if it has a wavelength of 0.1 meters and a frequency of 3 x 10^9 Hz?

Using E = hf, the energy is 1.989 x 10^-24 joules, a very small amount that is still enough to heat your food!
fact.tl:
Gaano karaming energy ang dala ng microwave kung may wavelength itong 0.1 metro at frequency na 3 x 10^9 Hz?

Gamit ang E = hf, ang energy ay 1.989 x 10^-24 joules, isang napakaliit na halaga na sapat pa rin upang painitin ang iyong pagkain!
fact.bis:
Pila ka energy ang dala sa microwave kon adunay wavelength nga 0.1 metros ug frequency nga 3 x 10^9 Hz?

Gamit ang E = hf, ang energy kay 1.989 x 10^-24 joules, usa ka hilabihan ka gamay nga kantidad nga igo pa nga makapainit sa imong pagkaon!

cards.illustration: A microwave oven heating a plate of food, with a small energy packet drawn next to it.

fact.en:
How much energy does a UV ray carry at a frequency of 4.25 x 10^15 Hz?

Using E = hf, the energy is 2.82 x 10^-18 joules, which is why UV rays can damage living cells!
fact.tl:
Gaano karaming energy ang dala ng UV ray sa frequency na 4.25 x 10^15 Hz?

Gamit ang E = hf, ang energy ay 2.82 x 10^-18 joules, kaya nakakasira ng mga buhay na selula ang UV rays!
fact.bis:
Pila ka energy ang dala sa UV ray sa frequency nga 4.25 x 10^15 Hz?

Gamit ang E = hf, ang energy kay 2.82 x 10^-18 joules, mao nga makadaot sa mga buhing selula ang UV rays!

cards.illustration: A UV ray from the sun hitting a skin cell, with a small energy packet labeled 2.82 x 10^-18 J.
